description: Turn the still-image clips of a sequence into video clips that exactly fill their beat-snapped slots. Free — this tool itself generates nothing. aktion plan: one job per image clip, ready for lab_animate_batch — start image, the frame's motion (bewegung_en), and the SMALLEST duration the model can deliver that still covers the clip's timeline duration (a shorter video would end early and shift every later cut off the beat). Refuses with 409 if a start image is not accepted yet. Pass the returned `jobs` unchanged to lab_animate_batch (get_cost first, then run). aktion einsetzen: once the videos are done, each finished video replaces its image clip — same duration, source in-point 0. Repeatable; reports what is still open and any video shorter than its slot (left as still). Run lab_beatgrid and lab_apply_rhythm on the sequence BEFORE plan, so the durations are the beat durations.

aktion.description: plan: build the animate jobs; einsetzen: put finished videos into the timeline
